annotations.text:
Chunky arcade / toybox — one direction, not a menu of them.
Barlow + Barlow Condensed are the fonts already in the project, so type is a size change, not a font change.
Body type here is 17px minimum; the shipped app was 14pt with 48 labels under 12pt.
The open question. Three cards across a phone is why the card text is 6.6pt today. Pick one of these three and the rest of the direction follows.
